## NextEra Energy is
## Delivering for America

Grids don’t build or modernize themselves, and resilience doesn’t happen by chance. It happens when
you advance with purpose. NextEra Energy is always building — power plants of all kinds,
infrastructure to fuel them and the network to move the power they generate from coast to coast. 

 

### FPL: Shaping Florida's Energy Future

As America's largest electric utility, Florida Power & Light Company serves more than 6 million
accounts, providing electricity to around 12 million people in Florida. Known for its fuel- and
cost-efficient power generation, FPL focuses on keeping bills low while driving energy innovation
and reliability. FPL is leading the way in supporting Florida’s growth with continuous
infrastructure advancements.

[Visit FPL][28]

### NextEra Energy Resources: An Energy Pioneer

NextEra Energy Resources is advancing America’s energy future with the largest and most diverse
portfolio of power generation and infrastructure solutions. As one of the nation's top wholesale
generators of electric power, it leverages all forms of energy across renewables, storage, natural
gas and nuclear. NextEra Energy Resources offers a wide range of integrated solutions to help
utilities and businesses across the country meet their energy needs when and where they need it.

[Visit NextEra Energy Resources][29]

[ai artificial intelligence white outline icon]

## Understanding energy supply

Energy supply is the initial step in providing power to your home. In Ohio, customers can select
their energy supply from any Public Utilities Commission of Ohio (PUCO)-certified supplier.
Understand your options to make the best choice for you. You have the power to choose.

[ Learn more ][80]
[banner]

## New digital solutions, new account number, new redesigned bill

AES Ohio is investing in new digital solutions to better serve you. We are upgrading our 25-year-old
customer system with cutting-edge technology. This upgrade will lay the foundation for an improved
and simplified customer experience. As part of this process, we’re introducing a newly redesigned
bill, and customers will receive a new account number.

[ Learn more ][81]

Working with you, we’re improving lives by delivering greener, smarter energy solutions right here
in the Miami Valley. By modernizing the energy grid, AES Ohio will improve your experience with a
four-year plan that enhances reliability and efficiency while providing personalized seamless
service.

## The next generation of Battery Management Systems is designed to improve interoperability, bridge
## the gap between first-life and second-life Battery Energy Storage Systems (SL-BESS), increase
## adaptability, and strengthen battery value chains.

# WHAT IS BIG LEAP?

The BIG LEAP project is a Horizon Europe initiative aimed at improving the reliability of
second-life batteries (SLBs) by addressing interoperability in Battery Management Systems (BMS). It
develops a three-layer BMS architecture specifically designed for SLBs and integrates an adaptable
Energy Storage System (ESS) to ensure safe performance from first-life (FL) to second-life BESS
applications. 

# The BIG LEAP project is dedicated to overcoming barriers in the reuse of old batteries in energy
# storage

## OBJECTIVES

The overall objective of BIG LEAP is to enhance Second-Life Battery Energy Storage Systems (SL-BESS)
applications by designing efficient 3-layered Battery Management Systems (BMS) and Energy Storage
Systems (ESS), ensuring economic viability, flexibility, and industry-wide standardization.

**1**


BMS and ESS development
with three layers that make it easy to reconfigure batteries for different applications.

**2**


In-site End-of-Life (EoL) diagnosis and safety recalibration. We aim to extend the operational
lifetime of batteries while reducing refurbishing costs. 

**3**


Offering three degrees of openness for swift industrial deployment through our innovative Battery
Management System is interoperable, adaptable, and updatable.

# Energy Storage Built To Your Needs

##### Customer-driven solutions

Tackling complex customer needs with a focus on flexibility.

##### Diversified across durations

Uniquely addressing short, long, and ultra long duration requirements.

##### Applying technological breadth

Unparalleled expertise across battery, gravity, hydrogen, and software.

## Reinvent energy storage with us.

Energy Vault consults closely with customers to identify, design, and construct energy storage and
power solutions that maximize the economic and environmental value of their assets.

Our customer-centric, solutions-based approach is grounded in our belief that energy storage
technologies will continue to evolve rapidly, requiring a close customer connection, technology
diversification, and sustained innovation.

[feat_list_icn1]

##### Unmatched value proposition

We are the only energy storage company offering solutions encompassing short to long to ultra long
duration needs with proprietary battery, gravity, and hybrid-hydrogen technologies.

[feat_list_icn2]

##### Sophisticated software

Our cutting-edge software helps customers orchestrate and optimize storage - and other  energy -
assets for both operational and business performance.

[feat_list_icn3]

##### Commitment to innovation

We invest strategically in research and development, knowing that the future of energy storage is
constantly being reinvented.

## Energy Vault Resiliency Center

Our focus on innovative storage solutions is exemplified by the Energy Vault Resiliency Center,
which combines proprietary gravity technology and software to optimize energy dispatch and provide
grid support.

## Our Unique Approach

What differentiates Energy Vault from our peers? It’s not one single thing, but instead a
combination of characteristics that collectively translate into greater value for our customers.

# Energy Storage Built To Your Needs

##### Customer-driven solutions

Tackling complex customer needs with a focus on flexibility.

##### Diversified across durations

Uniquely addressing short, long, and ultra long duration requirements.

##### Applying technological breadth

Unparalleled expertise across battery, gravity, hydrogen, and software.

## Reinvent energy storage with us.

Energy Vault consults closely with customers to identify, design, and construct energy storage and
power solutions that maximize the economic and environmental value of their assets.

Our customer-centric, solutions-based approach is grounded in our belief that energy storage
technologies will continue to evolve rapidly, requiring a close customer connection, technology
diversification, and sustained innovation.

[feat_list_icn1]

##### Unmatched value proposition

We are the only energy storage company offering solutions encompassing short to long to ultra long
duration needs with proprietary battery, gravity, and hybrid-hydrogen technologies.

[feat_list_icn2]

##### Sophisticated software

Our cutting-edge software helps customers orchestrate and optimize storage - and other  energy -
assets for both operational and business performance.

[feat_list_icn3]

##### Commitment to innovation

We invest strategically in research and development, knowing that the future of energy storage is
constantly being reinvented.

## Energy Vault Resiliency Center

Our focus on innovative storage solutions is exemplified by the Energy Vault Resiliency Center,
which combines proprietary gravity technology and software to optimize energy dispatch and provide
grid support.

## Our Unique Approach

What differentiates Energy Vault from our peers? It’s not one single thing, but instead a
combination of characteristics that collectively translate into greater value for our customers.

enough to fuel humanity’s limitless potential. For more than 15 years, we’ve been reimagining
long-duration energy storage, applying our ingenuity to zinc-powered chemistry, high-density
configurations, and AI-enabled controls. We have created a commercially proven, U.S.-manufactured

### Enable resilient, reliable energy today

ESS iron flow technology is essential to meeting near-term energy needs. Demand from AI data centers
alone is projected to increase 165% by 2030 and electricity grids around the world will need to
deploy 8 TW of long-duration energy storage (LDES) by 2040 to meet clean energy targets. As demands
on the grid continue to grow, LDES will keep the lights on. 

### Make renewable baseload energy possible

ESS solutions capture excess energy when it is available to provide uninterrupted power when it’s
not. With up to 22 hours of energy storage, ESS’ scalable, flexible solutions enable intermittent
energy to provide baseload power to meet growing energy demand from AI data centers and an
increasingly electrified society. 

### Maximize value with flexible, cost-effective solutions 

ESS’ American-made solutions are rapidly deployable, available in months instead of years. Iron flow
technology delivers unlimited cycling with zero capacity degradation over a 25-year design life. 

[Explore Products][42]

## Leading the charge

ESS continues to lead the industry with a commitment to innovation, research and development that
underpins every iron flow battery project. These awards underscore our commitment to powering data
centers, companies and communities worldwide with clean reliable energy made possible with ESS’ iron
flow technology.

### Enable resilient, reliable energy today

ESS iron flow technology is essential to meeting near-term energy needs. Demand from AI data centers
alone is projected to increase 165% by 2030 and electricity grids around the world will need to
deploy 8 TW of long-duration energy storage (LDES) by 2040 to meet clean energy targets. As demands
on the grid continue to grow, LDES will keep the lights on. 

### Make renewable baseload energy possible

ESS solutions capture excess energy when it is available to provide uninterrupted power when it’s
not. With up to 22 hours of energy storage, ESS’ scalable, flexible solutions enable intermittent
energy to provide baseload power to meet growing energy demand from AI data centers and an
increasingly electrified society. 

### Maximize value with flexible, cost-effective solutions 

ESS’ American-made solutions are rapidly deployable, available in months instead of years. Iron flow
technology delivers unlimited cycling with zero capacity degradation over a 25-year design life. 

[Explore Products][42]

## Leading the charge

ESS continues to lead the industry with a commitment to innovation, research and development that
underpins every iron flow battery project. These awards underscore our commitment to powering data
centers, companies and communities worldwide with clean reliable energy made possible with ESS’ iron
flow technology.

# Thinking Batteries Further

We shape the future of transportation as a top tier technology-partner for the e-mobility sector,
offering sustainable energy storage solutions researched, developed, manufactured and trusted
world-wide.

We think batteries further!

[Read more][33]

### Solutions

Our solution portfolio offers a wide range of tailor-made and off-the-shelf products as well as
numerous services to make your batteries even better.

[Solutions][34]

### Products

Our products are made in world class manufacturing factories with a focus on sustainability and
performance.

[Products][35]

### Research & Development

We have a continuously growing team of highly trained experts working on new solutions in all major
markets supporting in pre-development, development and series support.

[Engineering][36]

Our approach to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) aligns with European sustainability goals,
emphasizing responsible product development and production. In line with the EU Battery Regulation
(2023/1542), we ensure compliance with strict sustainability, safety, and recycling requirements.

We are an international team that fosters people with a passion for sustainable technologies by
giving them the opportunity to create the change they envision for themselves and for the world, and
help us shape the future of e-mobility.

How can we help? Looking forward to hearing from you!

# Energy Storage
# For a Better World

Form Energy is an American company driving innovation in energy technology and manufacturing. Our
cost-effective, multi-day energy storage solutions are designed to ensure a clean, secure, and
reliable electric grid, even during prolonged periods of stress.

### Our Technology

The electric grid faces a growing challenge: meeting rising energy demand without compromising
reliability or affordability, all while becoming cleaner. Developed and made in America, our first
commercial product is an iron-air battery capable of cost-effectively storing energy for 100 hours
at a time, directly helping to solve these grid challenges.

[ Learn More ][58]

### Manufacturing Batteries in the Heart of the Rust Belt

At Form Factory 1, Form Energy’s first high-volume battery manufacturing facility in Weirton, West
Virginia, we are helping to reignite American manufacturing. Built on the historic site of the
former Weirton Steel mill, a hallmark of the nation’s industrial heritage, our 550,000-square-foot
facility employs nearly 400 people and showcases the possibilities of American ingenuity by
producing next-generation iron-air battery systems.

[ Learn More ][59]

### About Us

Driven by Form’s core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is deeply motivated
and inspired to create a better world. We are supported by leading investors who share a common
belief that low-cost, multi-day energy storage is a key enabler of a reliable and secure electric
grid.

[ Learn More ][60]

### We're hiring

We are hiring a team of exceptionally talented and driven individuals to work at our facilities in
West Virginia, Massachusetts, and California. If you are mission-driven and want to be part of
building energy storage for a better world, we would love to hear from you!

Serving More Than 60m Global Users, Having About 1500 Employees
Genew Technologies Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: 688418), established in 2005, is a national high-tech
enterprise specializing in fundamental communication equipment R&D and industry digitalization
solutions. Our business focuses on two key sectors: public network communication for operators
(core, access, aggregation layers) and private network applications for industries (smart mining,
low-altitude economy, smart emergency response, smart petrochemicals), offering integrated solutions
from devices to platforms.
Driven by a "dual-engine" global strategy, Genew Technologies actively invests in "New Quality
Productive Forces" particularly in satellite internet. We are advancing critical technologies across
satellite, ground, and terminal segments, positioning ourselves as a global satellite communication
solution provider.

#### HSE Director

Chris started his career in HSE while serving in the Royal Air Force, which he continued after
leaving the service and working for the Ministry of Défense, specializing in oil and gas storage and
construction.

 He left the public sector in 2012 and continued his career in the private sector, joining VTTI as
projects HSE manager, where he worked on oil and gas projects in Kenya, Cyprus, UAE, South Africa,
Croatia and Nigeria before joining GPS.

 He joined the GPS Group in December 2018 and is subsequently the HSE Director responsible for all
of the GES Group’s construction and development projects as well as providing guidance and support
to existing operations.

## Martine de Beer

#### New Projects & Commercial Manager EMEA

Martine has over 15 years’ experience in various commercial and management roles within the storage
industry.

After finishing her MBA, she started as a trainee at Vopak, where she joined the Commercial team of
the Chemical Terminals in Antwerp for five years. Martine subsequently joined VTTI, being part of
the Management Team of their Amsterdam terminal and thereafter became responsible for the Commercial
and Customer Service activities in the ARA region. After five years, Martine started her own
consultancy firm. She contributed to the successful realization of several projects at Vesta
Terminals, VTTI, MarTest Cambrian and Vattenfall, ranging from operational excellence to contract
management.

Martine joined GPS in 2017 as the General Manager of the GPS Amsterdam terminal and has thereafter
fulfilled the role of New Projects and Commercial Manager EMEA for GPS, and GES since its formation.
Her areas of expertise include project sourcing and execution, including permitting, project
management and operational excellence.

# Charging up America’s energy future.

We strengthen America’s energy future by building and operating battery reliability projects that
store electricity to deliver when and where it’s most needed.

## The GridStor commitment.

Each of us needs reliable electricity more than ever to heat and cool our homes, run our businesses,
and communicate with each other. GridStor develops, owns, and operates grid-scale battery energy
storage systems to support a dependable power supply in the regions we serve.

##### Determined.

Our leadership team has over 200 years of combined experience in developing, building, and operating
over 100 gigawatts of power generation and storage projects.
[ Team ][15]

##### Trusted.

Our financial backing by the Sustainability and Infrastructure Investing groups of Goldman Sachs
Asset Management supports our commitment to develop and build top-tier projects.
[ Read our story ][16]

##### Diligent.

We identify the highest-benefit locations for deploying energy storage to support grid reliability.
Our projects are designed to support reliability, affordability, and sustainability goals of the
regions we serve.
[ Read more ][17]

## Batteries are key to expanding domestic energy reliance and strengthening our infrastructure.

More than ever, electric power must be available around the clock. Our economy is increasingly
dependent upon electricity to power vehicles, run new industrial facilities, support digital
commerce, and provide public services. We deploy battery energy storage to ensure stability for our
economy and communities as our electric power system grows and changes.

# Charging up America’s energy future.

We strengthen America’s energy future by building and operating battery reliability projects that
store electricity to deliver when and where it’s most needed.

## The GridStor commitment.

Each of us needs reliable electricity more than ever to heat and cool our homes, run our businesses,
and communicate with each other. GridStor develops, owns, and operates grid-scale battery energy
storage systems to support a dependable power supply in the regions we serve.

##### Determined.

Our leadership team has over 200 years of combined experience in developing, building, and operating
over 100 gigawatts of power generation and storage projects.
[ Team ][15]

##### Trusted.

Our financial backing by the Sustainability and Infrastructure Investing groups of Goldman Sachs
Asset Management supports our commitment to develop and build top-tier projects.
[ Read our story ][16]

##### Diligent.

We identify the highest-benefit locations for deploying energy storage to support grid reliability.
Our projects are designed to support reliability, affordability, and sustainability goals of the
regions we serve.
[ Read more ][17]

## Batteries are key to expanding domestic energy reliance and strengthening our infrastructure.

More than ever, electric power must be available around the clock. Our economy is increasingly
dependent upon electricity to power vehicles, run new industrial facilities, support digital
commerce, and provide public services. We deploy battery energy storage to ensure stability for our
economy and communities as our electric power system grows and changes.

[ Learn more ][18]

About GTCAP 

Shanghai Green Tech （GTCAP） is a supercapacitor battery manufacturer and energy storage solutions
provider based in China. Founded in 1998, we are dedicated in researching and developing new energy
storage technology, breaking through energy storage technology, changing future energy landscape,
and providing superior energy storage solutions to the world.



GTCAP have obtained the ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001 certification, and strictly follow these
standards. Most of our battery products have been certified by international safety standards such
as CE,UN38.3,IEC62619,UL9540A,UL1973,CEI0-21 etc.



All the products must undergo strict testing and quality control during the production process with
the data recorded in the MES system, and 100% OQC is guaranteed before packing and delivery.

## Who We Are —
## Hangzhou HK Charger Co., Ltd.

**Hangzhou HK Charger Co., Ltd.** is a leading manufacturer specializing in **home, commercial, and
industrial energy storage solutions**, providing innovative systems for renewable integration, load
balancing, and intelligent energy management. The company focuses on delivering reliable, efficient,
and scalable energy storage products to meet the growing demand for clean, sustainable power.

HK Charger's portfolio includes centralized and distributed storage systems, mobile and modular
battery units, and hybrid solutions that seamlessly integrate with solar, wind, and other renewable
energy sources. Each system is designed with **smart monitoring, real-time performance tracking, and
advanced load balancing capabilities**, ensuring optimal energy efficiency, cost savings, and grid
stability across various applications.

💡 Committed to sustainability and technological innovation, we empower homeowners, businesses, and
industrial operators to optimize energy usage, reduce peak demand charges, and maintain reliable
power supply even in off-grid scenarios.

The company's mission is to provide smart, efficient, and sustainable energy storage solutions that
empower users to integrate renewable energy, enhance operational efficiency, and contribute to a
greener future. Our intelligent energy management features include remote monitoring, predictive
maintenance, and scalable modular design.

🌱 From residential rooftop solar storage to large-scale industrial grid stabilization, HK Charger
delivers end-to-end energy storage solutions built for performance, longevity, and sustainability.

        Impro supplies a broad range of components for construction equipment manufacturers,

        #### Agricultural Equipment
        
        Impro is a manufacturer and supplier of a wide variety of parts for agricultural equipment,
        including investment castings, precision machined components and sand castings for use in
        hydraulic systems, transmission systems and engines for combine harvesters, seeders and
        tractors.
        
        #### Hydraulic Equipment
        
        Impro manufactures and supplies high precision CNC machining components and investment
        castings to customers in the hydraulic equipment sector. Typical hydraulic components that
        Impro produces include custom valve spools, pump pistons, sleeves, and valve bodies.
        
        #### Aerospace
        
        At Impro, we use a variety of machining and casting techniques to produce aerospace
        components that meet industry standards and customer requirements.
        
        #### Medical
        
        Impro is a trusted partner to world-class OEMs in the medical industry for investment
        castings, sand castings and precision machined components. Our products are integrated into
        medical devices such as diagnostic equipment, surgical instruments, patient handling
        equipment and more.
        
        #### Energy
        
        Our manufacturing capabilities—including investment casting, sand casting and precision
        machining—allow us to make durable, high-quality components for the energy industry capable
        of meeting or exceeding industry standards and customer requirements.
        
        #### Other Industries
        
        Impro offers a wide array of capabilities to its customers, including investment casting,
        sand casting, precision machining, and surface treatment. No matter your industry, Impro is
        your go-to source for high-precision, high-complexity, and mission-critical components.

## Why Use This Reference Design?

Complete solution for learning Delta robot kinematics and vision integration

### DIY from Scratch
* 6-12 months development time
* Complex mechanical design + kinematics math
* Firmware debugging (stepper sync issues)
* Vision-control integration complexity
* High failure risk, no support
* Component compatibility guesswork

### Our Solution

Recommended
* Quick start for experiments
* Pre-calibrated arm parameters (150mm/281mm)
* Fully functional firmware (command queue + interpolation)
* Complete vision pipeline (YOLOv8 + coordinate mapping)
* Tested and documented reference design
* Verified hardware combination for learning

## System Architecture

Hybrid PC + ESP32 design for optimal performance

[System Architecture Diagram]

PC handles AI vision processing, ESP32 controls motors in real-time via GCode protocol

### PC (Python)

YOLOv8 Vision
Coordinate Mapping
GCode Generation
USB Serial (115200bps) GCode Protocol

### ESP32 (C++)

Delta Kinematics
Motor Control
Real-time Execution

### Why This Design?

#### PC for AI Processing

Handles compute-intensive YOLOv8 inference and complex coordinate transformations

#### ESP32 for Real-time Control

Microsecond-level motor control and kinematics calculations without OS latency

#### Decoupled Architecture

Standard GCode protocol allows easy debugging, upgrades, and software replacement

### Ready to learn more?

Complete technical documentation and tutorials available

support.

performance and safety.


### What are the applications of lithium-ion batteries?

They are widely used in electric vehicles (EVs), solar energy storage, industrial backup systems,
and portable electronics.


### How much do lithium-ion batteries cost in India?

Costs vary depending on battery size, technology, and use case. Prices range from affordable EV
batteries to premium industrial solutions.

durable batteries for EVs, solar storage, and more.

We provide batteries for electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, LCVs, solar storage, and custom
energy solutions for industrial applications.


### Are Neuron Energy’s lithium-ion batteries safe?

Yes. Our batteries feature intelligent Battery Management Systems (BMS), advanced thermal
protection, and rigorous safety protocols.

### Does Neuron Energy provide warranty and after-sales support?

Absolutely. We offer comprehensive warranties and responsive service support to ensure long-term
performance and customer satisfaction.


### Where can I buy Neuron Energy’s lithium-ion batteries?

#### About Us

## Meet OGO Energy

## Charge. Connect. Grow.

OGO(On-the-go) Energy, we are committed to transforming and decarbonising the environment through
our **Make in India initiative.** We design and develop advanced battery energy storage systems
(BESS) for both stationary and electric mobility applications. Our lithium-ion battery packs are
manufactured in-house, powered by our **indigenously developed Battery Management System (BMS).**

OGO Energy strives to be a leading provider of lithium-ion cell-based energy storage solutions. As a
**cell-to-container (C2C) system integrator,** we have the capability to build a significant portion
of the battery pack value chain.

Our strong **R&D foundation** and commitment to accelerating battery adoption in emerging markets
drive our innovation and impact.

#### About Us

## Meet OGO Energy

## Charge. Connect. Grow.

OGO(On-the-go) Energy, we are committed to transforming and decarbonising the environment through
our **Make in India initiative.** We design and develop advanced battery energy storage systems
(BESS) for both stationary and electric mobility applications. Our lithium-ion battery packs are
manufactured in-house, powered by our **indigenously developed Battery Management System (BMS).**

OGO Energy strives to be a leading provider of lithium-ion cell-based energy storage solutions. As a
**cell-to-container (C2C) system integrator,** we have the capability to build a significant portion
of the battery pack value chain.

Our strong **R&D foundation** and commitment to accelerating battery adoption in emerging markets
drive our innovation and impact.

ABOUT US


Wuxi PRD New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. (a subsidiary of Wuxi Quanyu Electronic Technology) is a
leading innovator and manufacturer of Smart lithium battery systems. Established in 2014, we're
committed to delivering innovative and customized energy solutions for industrial and commercial
applications. We specialize in R&D, production, and sales of lithium batteries and chargers, we
power diverse equipment—including floor scrubbers, forklifts, aerial platforms, heavy-duty trucks,
golf carts, and RVs—for clients worldwide, such as Kärcher, Tennant and Hako.

With 10+ years of expertise, our 7,500+㎡ automated facility houses 4 lithium battery lines, 2
charger lines, producing 100,000+ battery packs and 200,000+ chargers annually. Certified to ISO
9001, CE, UN38.3, CB, ETL, ROHS, REACH, we ensure zero-defect quality from raw materials to final
products. Our dedicated R&D team holds 80+ patents and develops proprietary technologies, including
self-designed BMS systems certified to IEC 60730. Supported by a European subsidiary in Poland and
strategic partnerships with top suppliers (EVE, CATL), we guarantee fast delivery, premium
materials, and cost-efficient solutions. At PRD, we combine innovation, quality, and global reach to
drive the future of energy storage. Our mission is to provide sustainable, safe, and
high-performance lithium battery systems that redefine efficiency across industries.

ABOUT US


Wuxi PRD New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. (a subsidiary of Wuxi Quanyu Electronic Technology) is a
leading innovator and manufacturer of Smart lithium battery systems. Established in 2014, we're
committed to delivering innovative and customized energy solutions for industrial and commercial
applications. We specialize in R&D, production, and sales of lithium batteries and chargers, we
power diverse equipment—including floor scrubbers, forklifts, aerial platforms, heavy-duty trucks,
golf carts, and RVs—for clients worldwide, such as Kärcher, Tennant and Hako.

With 10+ years of expertise, our 7,500+㎡ automated facility houses 4 lithium battery lines, 2
charger lines, producing 100,000+ battery packs and 200,000+ chargers annually. Certified to ISO
9001, CE, UN38.3, CB, ETL, ROHS, REACH, we ensure zero-defect quality from raw materials to final
products. Our dedicated R&D team holds 80+ patents and develops proprietary technologies, including
self-designed BMS systems certified to IEC 60730. Supported by a European subsidiary in Poland and
strategic partnerships with top suppliers (EVE, CATL), we guarantee fast delivery, premium
materials, and cost-efficient solutions. At PRD, we combine innovation, quality, and global reach to
drive the future of energy storage. Our mission is to provide sustainable, safe, and
high-performance lithium battery systems that redefine efficiency across industries.

# What can PVMARS's energy storage system do?

Solar panels generate electricity quietly and complete their power generation tasks. Power your
home, hotel, factory, etc need for a day.

But neither solar panels nor wind turbines can store electricity on their own. Once there is no
sunlight and no wind, you will lose their power generation function.

At this time, the energy storage system (ESS) can help you solve this problem.

PVMARS’s energy storage system includes gel batteries, lithium iron phosphate batteries, flow
batteries, etc. Use batteries to store electricity generated by solar panels and wind turbines.

You will have electricity at your fingertips, making it available wherever power is needed.

Don’t wait anymore, start your electricity plan today!

## About Us

Founded in 1961, the **LNJ Bhilwara Group** is a leading Indian industrial conglomerate with 17
companies, 21 manufacturing units, and 9 marketing offices, operating across textiles, power
generation, graphite electrodes, and IT services in over 80 countries.

**Replus Engitech Private Limited, **develops advanced lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems
(BESS) to support India’s clean energy transition. It offers battery solutions for EVs
(2W/3W/e-rickshaws/e-buses/fleets), residential, telecom, and stationary storage, along with
customized products like AGV, UPS, and inverter batteries.

With in-house expertise in BMS/EMS, battery monitoring, and cell integration, REPLUS enables
gigafactory-scale assembly and provides end-to-end ESS solutions—from design and manufacturing to
commissioning and lifecycle support—driven by a team with deep renewable energy expertise.

## Our Offerings

Powering electric mobility with high-performance battery packs for 2W, 3W, buses, and commercial
vehicles.
Designed for efficiency, safety, and seamless integration across platforms.

Reliable lithium-ion energy storage systems for residential, telecom, and industrial backup.

Tailor-made battery solutions for AGVs, robotics, and specialized applications.

## About Us

Founded in 1961, the **LNJ Bhilwara Group** is a leading Indian industrial conglomerate with 17
companies, 21 manufacturing units, and 9 marketing offices, operating across textiles, power
generation, graphite electrodes, and IT services in over 80 countries.

**Replus Engitech Private Limited, **develops advanced lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems
(BESS) to support India’s clean energy transition. It offers battery solutions for EVs
(2W/3W/e-rickshaws/e-buses/fleets), residential, telecom, and stationary storage, along with
customized products like AGV, UPS, and inverter batteries.

With in-house expertise in BMS/EMS, battery monitoring, and cell integration, REPLUS enables
gigafactory-scale assembly and provides end-to-end ESS solutions—from design and manufacturing to
commissioning and lifecycle support—driven by a team with deep renewable energy expertise.

## Our Offerings

Powering electric mobility with high-performance battery packs for 2W, 3W, buses, and commercial
vehicles.
Designed for efficiency, safety, and seamless integration across platforms.

### [Mobility][19]

Reliable lithium-ion energy storage systems for residential, telecom, and industrial backup. 
Engineered for uninterrupted power, grid support, and energy optimization. 

### [Stationary][21]

[ Read more ][22]
Tailor-made battery solutions for AGVs, robotics, and specialized applications. 
Flexible designs that meet unique operational needs with precision and durability.

## Welcome to Reynold India Pvt. Ltd.

**Established in 1995**, Reynold India is an Indian company specializing in the design and
manufacturing of [industrial water chillers and cooling solutions][127]. It stands as one of the
largest producers of high performance chillers in the country, with a broad range of products that
serve industries like pharmaceuticals, plastics, food processing, and power generation. Our
offerings include **air cooled and water cooled chillers**, as well as **[customized
chillers][128]** for specific applications such as **[medical equipment][129]** and hazardous
environments.

Our rigorous dedication to innovation, quality, and energy efficiency has made Reynold chillers a
respected name in both domestic and international markets, exporting to over **63+** countries
across the world. We also offer machines that comply with international certifications such as
**ASME, CE, UL** etc to ensure reliability across diverse industrial needs.

Our founder and **CEO, Susanta Rakshit**, along with the management team, has grown Reynold India
from modest beginnings into a global competitor operating out of three manufacturing facilities,

## Who Is SAKO ？

SAKO specializes in developing, producing, and selling power & solar products; SAKO is a specialist
in off-grid solar systems and storage lithium batteries. SAKO’s main products are off-grid
inverters, lithium batteries, photovoltaic modules, and home energy storage systems. SAKO will
provide you with a full range of solar products and professionally customized solutions.

SAFE. POWERFUL. INTELLIGENT.
Lithium-Ion Battery

##### Who We Are

Scion Energy Storage is the bridge from the current limitations on power consumption to transforming
the way we power our world in the future. Energy storage technologies are critical for this
transformation. At this point in time, we believe Lithium powered batteries are the answer to this
need for a leap into the future. We provide an extensive range of customised Lithium Battery Storage
solutions in mobility as well as storage applications. Scion Energy Storage caters to electric
vehicles such as bikes, rickshaws, bicycles, e- golf carts, Automated Guided Vehicles and more.
Storage applications such as Handheld Devices, Solar Street Lights, Medical Instruments are catered
by Scion.

[ Read More][14]

##### Why Us
* [Safe][15]
* [Powerful][16]
* [Customer Service][17]
* [Intelligent][18]
* [Customization][19]
* [Gen-Next Innovation][20]


“Safety isn’t expensive, it’s priceless”, we take this motto in our actions. With Safety as our
priority, we ensure safety measures in all processes as well as ensure the final Lithium Battery is
safe. We take stringent measures and procedures to ensure maximum battery safety of our customers as
well as employees.

“A market is never saturated with a good product, but it is very quickly saturated with a bad
one.” We take relentless efforts and we are always charged up in providing you with a Lithium
Battery that will enhance the customer experience and deliver powerful energy storage solutions that
last long.


“Customer Service should not be a department. It should be the entire company. The sole reason we
are in business is to make life easier for our customers.” With a firm belief in offering the world
class customer service experience. We go an extra mile to meet the customer’s requirements of energy
storage and lithium batteries.


“The first step is to start with customer experience and then work backwards towards the
technology.” Our intense efforts to build a smart and intelligent Lithium Battery that understands
the precise need of our customers is what makes us stand out from the crowd. Behind the simplest
product which fulfills the exact requirements of the customer is an intelligent design and
manufacturing process.


“Don’t find customers for your products, find products for your customers.” We spend relentless
efforts in order to build numerous designs and innovation in developing Lithium batteries that suit
the customer’s specific application and design at a personal level. We believe each customer
requirement is a fresh canvas and put in our colours to deliver an excellent Lithium Battery.


“Never before in the history of mankind has the pace of innovation and technological acceleration
been faster than it is today.” With a dedication to innovation we are continuously developing and
working with new technologies to make our Lithium battery even more user-friendly, smart, reliable
and safe. With a global outlook we strive to keep innovating

## For **Your Business**

Solar & Solar Wholesale Group is one of the fastest growing distributor of PV modules, inverters,
energy storage and electrical components in Central Europe. We operate in 5 markets, offering solar
components only from the best brands. Our 4 logistics centers in Europe enable quick and affordable
delivery to our partners.

## Solar PV **Distribution**

Our expertise as a solar wholesale specialist is underpinned by a strong network of longstanding
partners, cutting-edge technology, state-of-the-art systems, and a team of dynamic professionals. As
the go-to wholesaler for photovoltaic supplies and systems, we pride ourselves on being deeply
entrenched industry insiders. We serve as service providers, optimization specialists, consultants,
and proactive problem-solvers. Above all, we are your trusted partners in the solar sector.

By focusing our operations on the wholesale distribution of all necessary components for a PV
system, Solar&Solar is dedicated to advancing the accessibility and efficiency of solar power
generation. Our mission is to empower our clients with smart technology and expert guidance, making
solar energy a practical and sustainable choice for all.

[About Us][49]
View More

Of **Solar & Solar 2026**
When you think of photovoltaics, the image that often comes to mind is a roof adorned with solar
panels. These essential products remain at the core of our offerings at Solar&Solar, a leader in the
solar wholesale market. However, our range extends far beyond just panels. We are proud to supply a
comprehensive selection of products necessary for the successful completion of photovoltaic (PV)
projects. Whether it’s for private residences, businesses, or large-scale solar farms, we offer
solutions tailored to every need, from individual components to all-in-one packages.

Our extensive product catalog is accessible 24/7 through our online webshops, which are designed to
streamline your shopping experience.

At Solar&Solar, we are more than just a [solar wholesale][50] provider; we are a comprehensive
resource for all your PV project needs, ensuring that every aspect of your solar venture is
supported by quality products, excellent service, and attractive pricing.

Hybrid solid-state battery technology is designed to improve thermal stability by reducing the
amount of liquid electrolyte. System safety also depends on the BMS, thermal management, electrical
protection and fire suppression design. Model-specific safety reports are available upon request.

Yes. Based on your electricity consumption, local tariff structure and operating strategy, our
engineering team can provide a preliminary capacity recommendation, system configuration and ROI
assessment.

Which certifications are available for MegSolid energy storage systems?

Certification availability depends on the product model and destination market. We can provide
model-specific certificates and third-party test reports for review before quotation and order
confirmation.

How is the safety of a hybrid solid-state BESS verified?

Hybrid solid-state battery technology is designed to improve thermal stability by reducing the
amount of liquid electrolyte. System safety also depends on the BMS, thermal management, electrical
protection and fire suppression design. Model-specific safety reports are available upon request.

What system capacities are available?

Our portfolio includes outdoor C&I energy storage cabinets and containerized BESS solutions,
covering projects from approximately 215kWh to 5MWh. Multiple systems can be connected in parallel

# Join SEIA’s Storage Network

 

Established in 2019, SEIA’s Energy Storage Committee has grown into a 300+ member network with
access to exclusive data insights and discounts for events like [RE+][9] and [RE+ Storage][10].

Established in 2019, SEIA’s Energy Storage Committee has grown into a 300+ member network with

# **Policy Advocacy******

Our team is advocating for critical laws and forward-thinking policies that are shaping the future
of energy storage and securing a more resilient, reliable, and sustainable energy system for
communities nationwide.

#### **ILLINOIS**

SEIA led a broad coalition to pass a** 3,000 MW procurement for Battery Energy Storage Systems**
(BESS). This legislation will break open new markets for grid-scale, distributed, and
behind-the-meter energy storage while saving Illinois customers an estimated $13 billion over 20
years.

#### **NATIONAL**

SEIA’s congressional team kicked into overdrive in 2025 and **saved the investment tax credits for
BESS,** ensuring policy certainty and financial security for most projects.

#### **COLORADO**

SEIA secured a major victory with the state’s Public Utility Commission with **the adoption of a
Virtual Power Plant program and flexible interconnection tariff requirements**, which will create
major market opportunities for energy storage.

# **Policy Priorities**

With boots on the ground in roughly 15 states and a deep bench of experts advocating for our
industry in Congress and at the federal agencies, SEIA is fighting to open markets for energy
storage across the country.

#### Defend and implement federal BESS policies
* SEIA advocates for reasonable and attainable Foreign Entities of Concern (FEOC) guidance and
  Treasury Department rules.
* SEIA is actively fighting to protect federal programs in the Executive Branch that promote storage
  development.
* Finally, SEIA is working to preserve the supply and affordability of BESS products as supply
  chains onshore and decouple themselves from FEOC countries.

#### Launch and implement state-level programs to financially support energy storage

In states across the country, SEIA is leading legislative and regulatory efforts to ensure that
utilities open paid programs for grid-scale and distributed BESS, both front-of and
behind-the-meter.

#### Secure fair access to markets

SEIA fights for fair valuation of energy storage in forward capacity markets (Effective Load
Carrying Capacity – “ELCC”) for grid-scale and distributed BESS.

#### Reduce interconnection costs
* SEIA advocates for flexible interconnection tariffs so BESS can get on the grid faster and more
  affordably.
* SEIA is continuing our steadfast support for surplus interconnection service at regional
  transmission organizations (RTOs) and independent system operators (ISOs).

#### Secure favorable retail rates for distribution BESS

SEIA pushes the implementation of affordable distribution retail rates so projects can
cost-effectively pull energy from the grid to charge.

#### Lower barriers to siting
* SEIA is working to keep cities and counties “open for business” for BESS, leading to lower bills
  and higher reliability.
* SEIA policy experts are diligently crafting and promoting bills that streamline BESS siting while
  opposing and defeating bills with onerous siting requirements.

* SEIA is continuing our steadfast support for surplus interconnection service at regional

cost-effectively pull energy from the grid to charge.

#### Lower barriers to siting
* SEIA is working to keep cities and counties “open for business” for BESS, leading to lower bills
  and higher reliability.
* SEIA policy experts are diligently crafting and promoting bills that streamline BESS siting while
  opposing and defeating bills with onerous siting requirements.
* In conjunction with our state affairs and codes & standards team, SEIA experts are guiding state
  officials in setting evidence-based standards for siting and fire protection.
* In a time of regulatory uncertainty, we are continuing to push Federal agencies to issue permits
  in accordance with laws and reasonable regulations.

# **Codes and Standards**

The deployment of energy storage is heavily impacted by building, electrical, and fire codes. In
forums across the country, SEIA has experts advocating for reasonable, consistent, and
evidence-based codes and standards that maintain the highest levels of safety without inflating the
costs to build.

[Learn More][15]

#### Regional Consistency

SEIA is advocating to ensure BESS systems have consistent installations and maintenance across all
states and regions. Our policy experts are prioritizing coordination of Code Provisions, ensuring
hazard prevention and mitigation.

#### Clear Guidance

SEIA is focusing on improving permitting and siting guidance for BESS to enable safe, scalable,
long-term deployment of residential, small-scale commercial, and large-scale BESS systems. SEIA
supports simplifying the International Residential Code.

#### Collaborative Development

SEIA is working to close regulatory gaps across the battery lifecycle. Partnering with industry
members, we prioritize knowledge-sharing and development of proper code chapters and sections on
battery collection, sorting, and recycling.

#### Policymaker Engagement

SEIA policy experts are creating model ordinances in order to engage and educate decision-makers at
federal agencies and other regulatory bodies.

A family of 15 across three generations runs a fully self-sufficient estate in South Netherlands,
growing around 70% of their own food, pumping water from 50 metres underground, and generating all
their own power from roughly 300 solar panels.

[How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers]

At the end of a weak rural grid in County Offaly, a print and design studio lost power every time a
neighbouring farmer milked his cows.

exceptional honour. Our 50 Years of Victron Energy film has won bronze at the annual Telly Awards,
competing against some of the biggest names in documentary filmmaking.

This converted cow barn is quietly running a global payment app used by over a million people around
the clock.

### Why 15 People Share One Off-Grid Estate in the Netherlands

A family of 15 across three generations runs a fully self-sufficient estate in South Netherlands,
growing around 70% of their own food, pumping water from 50 metres underground, and generating all
their own power from roughly 300 solar panels.

[How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers]

### How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers

At the end of a weak rural grid in County Offaly, a print and design studio lost power every time a
neighbouring farmer milked his cows.

[Telly Award for 50 Years of Victron Energy film]

### Telly Award for 50 Years of Victron Energy film

A rare interview with Victron's founder Reinout Vader and his son, CTO Matthijs, has led to an
exceptional honour. Our 50 Years of Victron Energy film has won bronze at the annual Telly Awards,
competing against some of the biggest names in documentary filmmaking.

[Inside the Dutch Barn that must NEVER Lose Power]

### Inside the Dutch Barn that must NEVER Lose Power

This converted cow barn is quietly running a global payment app used by over a million people around
the clock.

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[Power plant in the desert]
[Service men at pier]
[Freight vessel in port]

## Interim report for April-June 2026 has been published

In the second quarter of 2026, Wärtsilä’s total order intake increased by 33% to 2,849 MEUR to an
all-time high quarter, contributing to an all-time high order book of 8,976 MEUR. The operating
result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

[Read more][11]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][12][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][13][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][14][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.

[Our story][18]

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[Power plant in the desert]
[Service men at pier]
[Freight vessel in port]

## Interim report for April-June 2026 has been published

In the second quarter of 2026, Wärtsilä’s total order intake increased by 33% to 2,849 MEUR to an
all-time high quarter, contributing to an all-time high order book of 8,976 MEUR. The operating
result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

[Read more][11]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][12][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][13][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][14][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.

[Our story][18]
